findings.summary: The change at reviewed tree 3a8251f meets all three acceptance criteria for CODEX-01-A (spec blob d5014b5e…, architecture v1.2 SHA-256 02adc2e0…, authorized by the DECISION-038/APPROVAL-005 synthetic-foundation exception). resolveLoopConfig and isSyntheticPreviewEnabled follow the exact interfaces in the card. main.tsx passes only the three allowlisted preview flags. The existing demo routes and their About fallback are unchanged, and /loop-preview is a clearly labelled local shell with no forms or fake features. vercel.json keeps its routes and sets git.deploymentEnabled=false, and the manual-only Pages workflow is untouched. The controller ran checks on this tree: the unit tests covered the refusal paths, the production build succeeded, the real main.tsx router passed 28 module-identity cases, and a seeded secret/fixture scan of the production output and source passed. The remaining problems are stale records and gaps in the configuration denylist. None of them blocks acceptance. Unresolved provider, privacy, offer and release gates stay open, and nothing here authorizes provisioning, spending or deployment.

findings.title: Status JSON and report header still say blocked; wrong commit
findings.problem: state is "blocked" and result_commit is 7ee37b0. That commit is older than the implementation commit 0e5b949 and the verified tree 3a8251f. REPORT.md also still opens with 'Status: blocked … not done or accepted' and 'no files written'. Only the appended section records the passing re-verification. The card says the completion record must give exact revisions and checks, so these records contradict the evidence and point to the wrong commit.
findings.fix_check: After acceptance, the status file names the exact accepted/reviewed commit (3a8251f or its merge) and is no longer 'blocked'. REPORT.md states the current status at the top and names the exact tree or commit the controller checks ran against.

findings.title: Completion record lacks owner, exact revision and downstream IDs
findings.problem: The card's handoff requires the actual owner, the artifact or local output, exact revisions, checks, unresolved issues and downstream IDs. The re-verification section says only 'on this tree', with no commit or tree hash. The execution owner is still unassigned. Downstream IDs (CODEX-01-B/01-C) appear only in the stale blocker section.
findings.fix_check: REPORT.md names the reviewed commit or tree hash, the producing agent or owner, and downstream IDs in a current, non-blocked handoff section.

findings.title: Denylist misses some neutral-named remote/credential settings
findings.problem: The card requires the local result only 'without remote connection strings'. Detection relies on key-name patterns and a value-scheme check that covers only postgres, mysql, mongodb and redis. Some settings would still be accepted: PGHOST/PGPASSWORD, a bare PASSWORD key, amqp:// or smtp:// values, and https:// service URLs under neutral key names (for example SERVICE_URL=https://x.supabase.co). Nothing reads these settings today, so the risk is low. Still, the guarantee is weaker than the card's wording.
findings.fix_check: Either extend the refusal rules (for example PG*/PASSWORD keys and any URL with credentials or a remote host in a value), with tests for each, or document the denylist limits as an accepted residual for downstream modules (01-B/01-C).

findings.title: Reviewer could not read the controller checker source
findings.problem: Read access to .codex/tools/check_application_card.py was denied in this review. That means I could not check what the 28 route-identity cases or the seeded secret scan actually assert. I relied on the controller output supplied with the review request, plus my own reading of main.tsx, the tests, vercel.json, .gitignore (.env* ignored) and pages.yml (workflow_dispatch only).
findings.fix_check: A later reviewer with read access confirms that the checker exercises the real main.tsx routes, including /loop-preview in production mode with the preview flag forced, and scans dist/ plus tracked source for the seeded values.
